'''Torsin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], leading a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Torsin's unit was tasked with reclaiming the [[Stillwater Farms]] in the [[Gorinth Agricultural Sector]], but carried a set of [[RK-9 soil devastator]]s as a last resort. Torsin's unit was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Balmorran resistance]], but Imperial forces came upon their bodies and were asked by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardmore]], Torsin's superior, to destroy the farms with the soil devastators.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torsin's body starts the mission "Salting the Fields" for Imperial players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
